description: This file defines a PHP class 'ConfiguratorViewSugarpdfsettings' that manages the administrative interface for configuring PDF settings within SuiteCRM. It handles display logic, security checks, form processing for saving or restoring configurations, and manages file uploads related to PDF headers and logos.

classes.name: ConfiguratorViewSugarpdfsettings
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to handle PDF configuration interface in SuiteCRM, including display, save, restore, and file upload operations.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if current user is admin, terminates execution if not.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns breadcrumb navigation links for the module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering the configuration page, processing form submissions for saving/restoring settings, and preparing data for template rendering.

methods.name: checkUploadImage
methods.description: Validates uploaded images for PDF logos before saving them.
